summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of AO-360. Backend: 45 pytest cases across health, auth (JWT/bearer+httpOnly cookie, generic error, bcrypt $2b$ hash), account lockout (5 fails -> HTTP 423 + audit), RBAC for all 5 roles, dashboard/me, executive dashboard (NPF 2.68% Sehat, score 111.9), ranking + tie-breaker + N/A at bottom, divide-by-zero N/A rules (both NA and NA_NO_TARGET), targets/achievements upsert, performance-setting weight validation + versioning, user management (temp password, force reset, reset-password, change-role history, activate/deactivate/delete), collection activity multipart upload with watermark + GPS fallback + admin review, import preview, all 4 XLSX exports, backup without password_hash. Result: 45/45 passed. Frontend: login page, wrong-password error, all 5 role logins/redirects/menus, executive KPI+charts, leaderboard 3 tabs, AO dashboard (113% Excellent), portfolio + kolek 1-5 cards, collection modal (GPS status, submit, list), users CRUD via UI, data mgmt export/backup downloads, audit search, NPF page, targets edit modal, force-change-password flow + logout. One CRITICAL frontend bug found in the global period filter.

minor.issue: Activity is accepted with ZERO photos and is stored with status_validasi='Valid' even though no photo/GPS exists (overall_validation defaults to 'Valid' when files list is empty). Spec requires photo documentation; should require >=1 photo or mark 'Lokasi Tidak Tersedia'.
Completely unauthenticated - any collection photo (customer name/watermark/GPS) is downloadable by URL without a token. The 'auth'/'authorization' params are declared but never validated.
Only data_type='portfolio' is implemented; any other data_type silently increments 'failed' for every row instead of returning 400 with a clear message.
target_npf_ratio is taken from an arbitrary targets doc via find_one({'target_npf_ratio': {'$gt':0}}) with no sort/ao filter -> non-deterministic when remedial AOs have different NPF targets.
Open to every authenticated role (e.g. ao_funding) - branch-wide NPF/portfolio totals are visible outside the intended roles.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: period string destructured in the wrong order - `const [pm, py] = (period || ...).split('-')` gives pm='2026' (year) and py='09' (month). Consequences: (1) month dropdown always renders 'Januari' regardless of the active period (verified: select.value='1', selectedIndex=0 while header subtitle says 'September 2026'); (2) year dropdown value is invalid and silently falls back to the first option; (3) picking any month/year writes a corrupted period (e.g. '09-08' -> subtitle 'Periode Agustus 09'), after which every dashboard/leaderboard/target query returns empty data (Admin dashboard showed 'Realisasi Lending Rp 0 / Ach N/A'). Fix: `const [py, pm] = (period || fallback).split('-')`.

integration_issues.issue: Downloaded files are named 'achievement.xlsx' / 'ao360_backup.json' - the period suffix the backend sets in Content-Disposition is overridden by the frontend, so exports for different periods overwrite each other.

Submitting the modal without a photo succeeds and the row shows Validasi='Valid' while Lokasi column shows 'Lokasi tidak tersedia' - contradictory state shown to the user (root cause is the backend default above).

issues: Uses native browser date/time pickers (<input type=date/time>) instead of the shadcn calendar component
Photo picker input is a hidden native input styled as a label - works, but has no selected-file count/preview feedback before submit
Raw unstyled native 'Choose File' control breaks the visual language of the rest of the app
Month select is visually truncated ('Septemb...') at 1920px width

action_items: CRITICAL: fix reversed period destructuring in /app/frontend/src/components/Layout.jsx (line ~57) -> `const [py, pm] = (period || fallback).split('-')`; then re-verify month/year filter drives dashboards correctly
Require at least 1 photo for collection activities (or set status_validasi to 'Lokasi Tidak Tersedia' when there are no photos/GPS) in POST /api/collection-activities
Protect GET /api/files/{path} with token validation (query param or Authorization header) so customer photos are not publicly downloadable
CORS: allow_origins=['*'] together with allow_credentials=True is invalid per the CORS spec - browsers will refuse credentialed (cookie) requests. Use explicit origins from env
seed.run() returns early when any user exists, so changing ADMIN_PASSWORD never updates the existing admin - make admin seeding idempotent (upsert password if changed)
Return 400 from /api/import/confirm for unsupported data_type instead of counting all rows as failed
Keep the period suffix in export/backup download filenames
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.jsx: `const [pm, py] = period.split('-')` swaps month/year - single-line bug that breaks the entire period filtering feature (highest priority).
server.py is 1001 lines and mixes auth, RBAC, dashboards, files, import/export and backup - split into routers (auth, users, dashboard, portfolio, collection, data_mgmt) before Phase II.
/api/files/{path} declares `auth`/`authorization` params but never uses them -> unauthenticated object access to watermarked customer photos.

/api/restore/confirm does delete_many({}) on 11 collections including users before insert_many; the advertised 'auto-backup before restore' only writes an audit log, so a malformed payload is unrecoverable. (Not executed during testing to avoid wiping demo data.)
seed.py guards on users.count_documents({}) > 0, so demo targets/achievements/portfolio can never be re-seeded or migrated; admin credentials from env are ignored after first boot.
hitung_npf/hitung_achievement correctly return None for divide-by-zero and the ranking helper places N/A rows last with rank=null - verified, no changes needed.

rca_of_the_issue: Period filter: Layout.jsx computes `const [pm, py] = (period || `${year}-${month}`).split('-')`. Since period is stored as 'YYYY-MM', pm receives the year and py the month. The month <select value={parseInt(pm)}> therefore gets 2026, which matches no <option> (1-12), so the browser falls back to index 0 ('Januari'); the year <select value=py> gets '09', which matches none of [2026,2025,2024] and falls back to 2026 by coincidence. On change, setP(m, y) builds `${py}-${pad(m)}` = '09-08', an invalid period that the backend has no data for, so all achievement/ranking widgets render Rp 0 / N/A. Reproduction: login as any role -> header month dropdown reads 'Januari' while the subtitle reads 'Periode September 2026' -> select 'Agustus' -> subtitle becomes 'Periode Agustus 09' and KPI cards go to Rp 0 / Ach N/A. Mitigation: swap the destructuring to `const [py, pm] = ...`.
